name: io.github.xozxro/dropify-mcp
title: Dropify
description: The hub for official-store product data: prices, stock and restocks on 500k+ merch products.

environmentVariables.name: DROPIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Adds the 7 token tools to the 3 that work without one. Tokens come with All Access. Create one at https://app.dropify.cloud/developers.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN, with your Dropify token in place of YOUR_TOKEN. Tokens come with All Access. Create one at https://app.dropify.cloud/developers.
